_note: Community racing venues. Racing isn't an official game mode — these are run by the Buckyball Racing Club and the canyon/SRV-racing community. `match` auto-ticks when you've visited the venue's system.
blurb: Elite has no official racing mode — races are community-run (a pilot marks the start line with a mining laser; when it winks out, you go). These are the venues the Buckyball Racing Club and the canyon-racing community are known for. Auto-ticked when you've been to the system.

racetracks.name: Buckyball Run A*
racetracks.why: The club's flagship: race to the galactic core in the shortest time. The ultimate long-distance run.

racetracks.name: The BuckyBubble (A* Challenge)
racetracks.why: The famous ~60-system circuit loosely shaped like a buckyball molecule — the race the club is named for.

racetracks.name: Hutton Orbital Run
racetracks.why: The legendary ~90-minute supercruise slog to Hutton Orbital — a rite of passage, and the mug.

racetracks.name: Colonia Trophy Dash
racetracks.location: Dove Enigma → 7 stations → Jaques Station, Colonia
racetracks.why: A classic multi-station circuit around the Colonia region, finishing at Jaques Station.

racetracks.name: Elite Buckyball Triathlon
racetracks.location: Siren system (+ SRV stage on Wasat A 2 E)
racetracks.why: Three stages: a Station Scramble, a Bubble Tour, and a 50 km SRV leg — the club's full gauntlet.

racetracks.name: Ross 1047 Drag Strip
racetracks.why: Drive 10 km out along a ridge from Cortes Base and back — a pure SRV speed test.

racetracks.name: Wasat SRV Stage
racetracks.location: Elwood Camp → Ferguson Prospect, Wasat A 2 E
racetracks.why: A 50 km cross-country SRV leg used in the Buckyball Triathlon.

racetracks.name: Sandy Ring Racetrack
racetracks.why: A beloved fan-made canyon course — technical and hugely fun once you've learned the line.

racetracks.name: Cupinook Canyons
racetracks.why: A dramatic canyon network long popular for SRV racing.

racetracks.name: Ariel Ridges
racetracks.why: Canyons and mega-ridges on Ariel — racing in the home system itself (permit required).

racetracks.name: Pomeche Ridges
racetracks.why: A planet of striking ridges and canyons, a community favourite.

racetracks.name: 19 Phi-2 Ceti Track
racetracks.why: A natural canyon with vivid yellow markings that look like painted race lines.

racetracks.name: Alioth Canyons
racetracks.why: Neat canyon country in the Alliance capital (permit required).
